objective: Redesign the post card: icon-only like, reply and repost controls each followed by a live count ('x likes', 'x replies', 'x reposts', singular at one), a one-click repost toggle that updates at once, and reposts rendered as the post they repost, so a post reads as a post and every control shows what it did.
acceptance_criteria: The like, reply and repost controls show an icon and no visible word; each has an accessible name (Like or Unlike, Reply, Repost or Undo repost) and the like and repost controls carry aria-pressed reflecting the viewer's state.

Next to each control is its count as text: '0 likes', '1 like', '2 likes'; '0 replies', '1 reply', '2 replies'; '0 reposts', '1 repost', '2 reposts', from like_count, reply_count and repost_count, with thousands separated in the viewer's locale.

Pressing like updates the icon state and the like count at once, before the server answers, and puts both back and shows an InlineAlert if the request fails; the same holds for repost, which calls POST /posts/{id}/repost or DELETE /posts/{id}/repost by the viewer's current state.
The optimistic like and repost change every cached copy of the post at once (the feed, a thread, search results, and the post shown inside a repost), so two cards of one post never disagree.
A signed-out viewer pressing like or repost is sent to sign-in with a return address, and nothing is called.
Pressing reply does not change the reply count; the count changes only when a reply is posted and the post's data is refetched.

A plain repost renders as a line naming who reposted it, with a repost icon, above the reposted post's own card (author, time, text, media, controls and counts of the original); its controls act on the original, and liking or reposting it updates the original everywhere.
A quote repost renders its own author, text and controls, with the reposted post shown inside it as a compact, bordered card that links to the original.

The card's states (default, hover, focus-visible, pressed, disabled while a request is in flight) are styled from tokens only, the pressed like and repost are distinguishable without colour (a filled icon), and every control keeps a hit area of at least 24 by 24 px (the post-footer rule of FrontendUI/components.md, WCAG 2.5.8).

Every *.module.css file this unit adds or changes contains no hex, rgb(), hsl() or named colour, no px font size, and no outline: none or outline: 0 without a :focus-visible rule in the same file (a static test reads the files from disk).

No existing file under frontend/src/components/ui/ is modified except icons/index.tsx (filled variants added), and the PR carries the browser checklist of FrontendUI/verification.md for the feed with a plain repost, a quote repost and a post with media, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide, with the axe row left to the human.
